name: Paws
description: The built-in animal paws feature (poke-out-to-override paw-pad + toe-bump shape on hands and feet). `paws` the boolean stays a real, resolved avatar3d_rig.py value even though it's not a named parameter of anything anymore - build_rig() still needs it to decide whether finger/thumb pivots get built at all (real animal paws have no separate articulated digits), see that function's own docstring.
